result.instructions: Tools for WebinarKit, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which webinars do we have scheduled, and when is each one?"; "List our webinar series and meetings."; "Show the dates of the webinar with id 123456.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes WebinarKit data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run webinarkit_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run webinarkit_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run webinarkit_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. webinarkit_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: webinarkit_list_webinars
tools.title: List webinars
tools.description: List the webinars on the account with their ids and titles. Good first call to find a webinar id. WebinarKit API: GET /api/webinars.

tools.name: webinarkit_get_webinar_dates
tools.title: Get webinar dates
tools.description: List the scheduled dates and times of one webinar. WebinarKit API: GET /api/webinar/dates/{id}.

tools.name: webinarkit_list_series
tools.title: List webinar series
tools.description: List the webinar series on the account (groups of related webinars). WebinarKit API: GET /api/series.

tools.name: webinarkit_list_meetings
tools.title: List meetings
tools.description: List the meetings on the account. WebinarKit API: GET /api/meetings.

tools.name: webinarkit_get_account
tools.title: Get a white-label sub-account
tools.description: Get one white-label sub-account by its email address. Only for white-label accounts. WebinarKit API: GET /api/account?email=.
